annotations.title: Select an actor for future adverts

description: Select an owned, ready actor (its actorId and current actorVersion from soclo_actors_list) to reuse in future adverts. Free, and only when the owner asks. Pass a stable clientRequestId; the current selection version is read for you. After an uncertain result read soclo_actors_current before choosing again.

actorId.description: The owned actor id, from soclo_actors_list.

actorVersion.description: The owned actor’s current actorVersion, from soclo_actors_list.

name: soclo_actors_select
